tasks.goal: Keep the project-owned planner/tooling branch healthy so routine wakes stay cheap, deterministic refill can keep the tree moving despite unrelated blocked leaves, planning packets expose enough model status to avoid duplicate work, and planner timeout/slowness metrics route back to the project owner with durable evidence.

context.root_cause: The planning packet (from planningPacket() in SDK) shows frontier task IDs and state counts, but does NOT include model path status. The LLM sees a path name in context but doesn't know it's already staging-pass. The deterministic seeder correctly excludes staging-pass — the LLM needs the same view.
context.evidence: net-integration-authorized-service-tags retried 11 times (frontier-20260616-1 through -11). Path was staging-pass since 04:49. Planner kept creating tasks because it didn't know.
context.principle: The infrastructure provides information. The LLM decides. Don't add guards to block wrong decisions — give the LLM the knowledge to decide correctly.
context.fix_direction: Include compact model status in the planning packet: passing count, non-passing paths with their status and root cause. The LLM then knows what's done and what actually needs work.
context.rollup_summary: Planner context quality branch completed: repaired deterministic refill and planner timeout behavior, restored live frontier/status surfaces, clarified authority order, routed planner slowness metrics back to the project owner, and recorded the remaining expectation that planner packets should expose enough model/path status to avoid duplicate work.
